transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

I’m having trouble staying focused on things I need to pay attention to at work. I’ll start a safety briefing or review a plan really trying to focus, but within a few minutes my mind’s off on three other job problems, and I miss things I know I should’ve caught.
How long have you been experiencing this trouble with staying focused?
About two years and two months now. It really got bad after the construction schedule changed and my hours became a lot more chaotic.
Did you have similar difficulties with focus or attention during your childhood or school years?

Yeah, even in elementary school. Teachers would tell my parents I couldn’t stay in my seat and I’d talk out of turn. I was always losing homework too, and I’d rush through directions before I really understood what I was supposed to do.
These days, do you often feel restless inside or find it difficult to sit still?
Yeah. In meetings, when everyone else can sit through the whole thing, I’m usually the one getting up—going for coffee, stepping outside to check something, finding some excuse to move around.
